facts.fact: New Era reports that NAM-CSIRT, the Namibia Cyber Security Incident Response Team, is housed under the Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia.

NAM-CSIRT's Q3 2026 newsletter, reported by New Era, urged organisations to patch SharePoint and VMware vCenter vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-50522, CVE-2026-59309, CVE-2026-59310) and examined two incidents, one at the Ministry of Defence and Veterans Affairs.
NAM-CSIRT recorded 506,143 cyber vulnerabilities and 163,053 cyber events in July to September 2026, a count of detections with no action stated.
